items.title: Expected collection date cannot be set on partly paid invoices
items.detail: The Unscheduled and Collections lists include partly paid overdue invoices and set expected_collection_date through PATCH /api/invoices/{invoiceId}, but that endpoint refuses date changes on any invoice with payments. Decide whether expected_collection_date is exempt from that refusal.
items.note: The only changed file is next-env.d.ts, a generated Next.js type reference file with no bearing on the PATCH /api/invoices/[invoiceId] handler; no change exempts expected_collection_date from the payment-based date refusal, so the item is not built.

items.title: Today text still names a non-existent endpoint
items.detail: The Today screen text still says the seller's actions call POST /api/alert, which is not defined. The correct endpoint POST /api/alerts/{alertId}/action-taken is now named in a separate line, so the stray reference must be removed from the Today text.

items.title: Public demo account has no entry point
items.detail: users.is_demo exists, but no screen or endpoint creates or opens a fictional demo account, while the PRD requires any public demo to be isolated and filled only with fictional data. Decide whether to drop the column or build a demo entry point.

items.title: Who sets the invoice number
items.detail: New Invoice asks the seller to enter the invoice number, but POST /api/invoices assigns a unique invoice_number on the server, and the issue endpoint assigns one when it is missing. Decide whether the seller types the number or the server assigns it.

items.title: Add a line item to an existing draft or unpaid invoice
items.detail: The POST items endpoint exists, but no screen reaches it, so a seller cannot add a T-shirt, gift or delivery charge after the invoice is created. The PRD asks to "Add printed T-shirts, crochet gifts and delivery charges as items on one invoice."

items.title: Edit a line item on a draft or unpaid invoice
items.detail: The PATCH item endpoint exists, but no screen reaches it, so a seller cannot correct a description, quantity or unit price on an invoice. The plan's Invoice Detail screen calls for an editable items table.

items.title: Remove a line item from a draft or unpaid invoice
items.detail: The DELETE item endpoint exists, but no screen reaches it, so a line entered by mistake cannot be removed. The PRD requires invoices to be correct before payments are recorded.

items.title: Reverse a payment recorded by mistake
items.detail: The DELETE payment endpoint exists, but no screen reaches it, so a wrongly entered advance or payment stays on the invoice. The PRD asks to be prevented from entering invalid amounts, and a mistaken receipt would otherwise distort the balance and forecast.
